text: Zay Z的課程Hello, boys and girls.Welcome to Jay Z's class.Today, we are going to start unit 3.In this period, you are going to learn about the basic structure of an argumentative article and find out the opinion and reasons.Please get your student's book and the worksheet ready.Look at the articles and tell what type of writing the articles are.In 7A unit 2, we learned how to take care of a puppy and different rows of dogs in human history.These articles are, yes, they are expository articles.In 8B unit 5, we read a story about a blind man and his dog, Charlie.It's a narrative article.Well, today we are going to read an article about pad dogs, but from different perspectives.Look at the pictures, the title, and the introduction, and then answer the questions.Please look at the word in italics in question 3.OpinionOpinion means someone's feelings or thoughts about something.Read after me.OpinionOkay, you will have one minute to finish the article probably about?Yes, it is probably about whether keeping pad dogs is a good idea.The last one.Will their opinions be the same?No, probably not.Let's read the article and check it out.Read the article and think about the questions.OpinionOpinionOpinionOpinionOpinionOpinionOpinionOpinionOpinionOpinionOpinionNow let's check.'s take a look at the wordmess, extremelyCan you guess their meanings from the context?Yes, mess here means dirty thingsextremely means veryNow read after memess, messextremelySome of you may have difficulty getting the third reasonLet's read the paragraph again togetherWhat does this refer to?Great, it refers toThe dogs have to live in small spacesThis timeThe topic sentence is in the middle of the paragraphWell, let's find out how Matt supports his ideaRead Matt's part again and complete the mind mapYou can find this on your worksheet task 4One minute to do itEasy, right?Let's checkDogs live fur and hair at homeSome people are not good at cleaning up after their dogs outsideDogsBark at strangersFrighten young children and even bite peopleSome noisy dogs stop neighbors from sleepingDogs need fresh air and large open spacesTo run freePay attention to the words in redFur means the thick and usually softer hairThat grows on the bodies of many mammalsBite means cut something with one's teethWell, what can we learn from Matt's part?Think about itHe expresses his opinionHe expresses his opinionKeeping pet dogs is not a good ideaAnd he presents his reasons for that with topic sentences and supporting detailsFinally, he restates his opinion with a brief conclusionPeople should not keep pet dogsSo, from what we read just now, we can easily find out the basic structure of an argumentative article isOpinion, reasons, and conclusionReasons are also called argumentsNow let's go back to the titleRead the title again and answer the questionWhat does the title head-to-head mean?Two people or groups face each other directly in order to decideAfter
